Class RmiConnectionEntryPoint

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.virtualview.RmiConnectionEntryPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
RmiConnectionService, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiConnectionEntryPoint extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RmiConnectionService
RMI entry point for incoming client connections.

This object is bound to the server's RMI Registry. Each client calls it once to receive a dedicated VirtualViewRMI session.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public RmiServerService connect(RmiClientService clientCallback) throws RemoteException
      Description copied from interface: RmiConnectionService
      Creates a new server-side RMI session for one client.

      The clientCallback parameter is the remote object exported by the client. The server stores it in the new session and uses it later to send server-to-client messages and keep-alive pings.

      Specified by:
      connect in interface RmiConnectionService
      Parameters:
      clientCallback - client-side callback used by the server to push messages back to this client
      Returns:
      dedicated remote server session used by the client to send commands after connection setup
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the session cannot be created or the remote call fails
